result.title: Quality and Similarity Indicators for Video-Based Heart Rate and Respiratory Rate Fusion: A Controlled Evaluation
result.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables; with 14 pages supplementary material included
result.summary: Camera-based heart rate (HR) and respiratory rate (RR) estimates vary in reliability from window to window, and a common remedy is to fuse several extraction methods with weights from reference-free signal quality indicators. However, few studies test whether these indicators identify the most accurate method in each window or outperform simpler fusion. We evaluate 11 quality indicators and 8 inter-method similarity measures for fusing 7 HR and 10 RR extractors on four public datasets (75 test subjects). Filters, indicator directions, weighting parameters and a learned ridge baseline are selected on a separate five-subject set before testing. Fusion is compared with equal averaging, a constant typical-rate predictor, the best single method selected in advance and in hindsight, and a per-window oracle with a permutation-based null, using subject-level bootstrap confidence intervals. For HR, quality-weighted fusion reduced mean absolute error by 10.9% [5.2, 18.4] relative to averaging and by 15.6% [8.1, 23.1] relative to the method selected in advance, and was statistically indistinguishable from the best method selected in hindsight. Weighting methods by their agreement did not improve on averaging. For RR, the indicators could not identify the more accurate estimates: sharpened quality weighting increased error (-2.6% [-4.8, -0.8]), fused estimates were uncorrelated with the reference (r <= 0.22), and averaging was less accurate than the typical-rate predictor (-3.1% [-6.1, -0.4]). With a second respiratory reference, apparent RR gains reflected estimates moving toward its typical rate. Quality-guided fusion is worthwhile for video HR; for RR, 30-s windows improved estimates but not fusion.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在四个公开数据集上系统比较 11 种无参考信号质量指标与 8 种方法间相似度度量，用于融合 7 种心率与 10 种呼吸率提取器，并以等权平均、常数速率预测、预先/事后最佳单一方法及逐窗 oracle 加置换零假设为对照；结果显示质量加权对心率有效，对呼吸率无效，相似度加权未优于平均。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐窗无参考质量指标与相似度加权来挑选、融合多个估计器的做法，可供核查 LVR 中多候选 latent 假设与视觉证据的筛选和加权；其「相似度加权不优于等权平均」的负结果可能提示 latent 相似度需与内容可靠性区分，属跨领域方法线索。
